text:
This talk is a presentation of the scientific and technical expertises of the HPC@Maths team for a common seminar with Ananke team. For more details, please visit the following link:
https://hpc-maths.github.io/2026-ananke-hpcmaths

title: HPC@Maths
text:

3 post-docs
9 phd students

C++ 20 header only

A large collection of methods: eRK, DIRK, LRK, expRK, RKC, Lie or Strang splitting
Highly flexible
